name: Unified Training: pretraining, SFT and RL under one likelihood objective
title: Unified Training: pretraining, SFT and RL under one likelihood objective
summary: Treats RL as learning from reward-weighted model generations, so one objective mixes pretraining data, demonstrations and successful RL solutions. In 124M-parameter experiments the best setups beat staged training on reasoning accuracy and harder unseen problems while forgetting less. Small scale only.
